# PlaysTV Retriever

> A free website for finding and recovering lost Plays.tv clips. Plays.tv shut down in December 2019 and its videos went offline; PlaysTV Retriever searches the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine for a username's archived Plays.tv profile and shows which clips can still be watched and downloaded.

## What it does

- Search a Plays.tv username at https://playstv-retriever.com/ (profile pages are at https://playstv-retriever.com/u/{username}).
- It finds the archived profile, lists its clips with thumbnails and previews, and checks whether each clip's full video was saved.
- Recovered clips play in the browser and can be downloaded. Clips the Wayback Machine never saved are listed separately as "Couldn't be recovered".

## Good to know

- Free, no account needed.
- It doesn't collect any private information; everything comes from the publicly available Wayback Machine.
- Not affiliated with Plays.tv or the Internet Archive.
- Looked-up profiles are kept, so a recovered profile loads instantly the next time.
- A feed at https://playstv-retriever.com/feed shows every recovered clip, newest upload first, and can be filtered by game.
